title: Always Planning Trips You Could Win a Swiss Holiday
paragraphs: In many groups of friends and families, there is usually one person who always plans the trips. Now, a travel company wants to thank these people with a free holiday in Switzerland.

The company is Klook, a website where people can book travel activities. In August 2026, it started a contest called "Thank You Travel Planners." Five winners will get a seven-day trip to Switzerland in December 2026. The prize includes flights, a nice hotel and activities, and Klook will plan everything. Each winner can also bring one other person with them.

To enter the contest, people had to write up to 300 words about a trip that they planned and the problems they solved. People could also enter the name of another person who always plans trips. The contest closed on August 31, 2026. People had to be at least 21 years old and have a passport. They also had to agree to be filmed during the trip for Klook's advertising.

Klook also did a survey of 2,725 travelers in 10 countries. It found that planning a trip is one of the jobs that people are thanked for the least. For eight in 10 people, planning one trip can take more than 10 hours. And 42% said that even when someone else plans a trip, they still worry and check the plans.

Marcus Yong, an executive at Klook, said that the company wants to make travel planning easier. "We built Klook to make travel planning simpler, so travellers can spend less time on admin and more time on experiences," he said. About the contest, he said, "It's their turn to take a vacation from planning vacations."
